title: rorca-forge-brief-first
_notes: Redesign Spec Forge from form-heavy to brief-first. Brief textarea becomes the hero element, all config collapses under Advanced Options, spec name auto-generates from brief. Sonnet-tier — UI refactor with minimal backend changes. Zero dependency on CIE/convention-agents — can run anytime.
_relatesTo: rorca-ui-redesign (established panel architecture), rorca-frontend-routing (can run in parallel — no overlap). Independent of pending specs.
_executionOrder: Can run immediately — no dependencies. Should run before rorca-e2e-testing so Playwright tests the brief-first flow.

userStories.title: Auto-Generate Spec Name from Brief
userStories.description: Make the `title` field optional in POST /api/specs/generate. Currently specs.ts line 374-381 returns 400 if title is missing. When title is not provided, auto-generate a kebab-case slug from the first 5-8 meaningful words of the brief (lowercase, strip stop words, max 60 chars). Extract the existing `titleToSlug()` function from BatchForge.tsx line 34 into a shared `src/lib/slugify.ts` utility. On the frontend, add a live preview of the derived spec name below the brief textarea in muted text (e.g. 'rorca-user-auth-oauth-flow'), updating as the user types with a 300ms debounce. The canGenerate guard in SpecForgePanelPage.tsx line 190 changes from requiring specName.length > 0 to only requiring specBrief.length > 0. If the user manually enters a spec name in Advanced Options, that takes precedence over auto-generation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/specs/generate with { workspaceId, brief } (no title) returns 200 and uses an auto-generated slug
The auto-generated slug matches KEBAB_RE pattern /^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/ and is max 60 chars
Frontend shows live preview of derived spec name below brief textarea, updating with 300ms debounce
Manual spec name entry in Advanced Options takes precedence over auto-generation
Shared briefToSlug() function lives in src/lib/slugify.ts and is used by both SpecForgePanelPage and BatchForge
Existing API callers that send title continue to work unchanged (backward compatible)

userStories.title: Brief-First Layout Reorganization
userStories.description: Restructure SpecForgePanelPage.tsx so the brief textarea is the first and most prominent element. Currently the layout flows: Spec Identity (name, domain, workspace) -> Direction Stack Overrides -> Spec Parameters (model, story count, prefix, diagram, output format) -> Brief textarea (buried at line 549). New layout: Brief textarea (large, auto-resize 4-16 rows, prominent placeholder 'Describe what you want to build...') -> auto-generated spec name preview from FG-001 -> Generate Spec + Quick Run buttons -> Advanced Options (collapsed, see FG-003) -> Progress/Output below. The three-pane layout stays: form left ~50%, Direction Preview Sidebar ~30%, output right. The brief textarea auto-focuses on mount. The 'Start from template' link stays visible near the brief input. Batch/Single mode toggle in the header is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Brief textarea is the first interactive element visible when Forge page loads (above the fold)
Brief textarea auto-focuses on mount
Placeholder text reads 'Describe what you want to build...'
Auto-generated spec name preview appears directly below the brief textarea
Generate Spec and Quick Run buttons appear immediately below the spec name preview
Direction Preview Sidebar (right pane) position and behavior unchanged
Batch/Single mode toggle unchanged
Start from template link remains accessible near the brief input

userStories.title: Collapsible Advanced Options Section
userStories.description: Create a collapsible 'Advanced Options' section containing all configuration fields currently displayed upfront: Spec Name (pre-filled with auto-generated slug), Domain, LLM Model selector, Story Count presets, Story Prefix, Include Diagram toggle + type radios, Output Format radios, and Direction Stack Overrides (L4/L5). Collapsed by default with a chevron toggle. When no fields have been modified from defaults, show 'Using defaults' hint next to the toggle. When any field has been modified, show a badge with the count (e.g. 'Advanced Options (2 customized)'). The existing section-by-section organization (Spec Identity, Spec Parameters, Direction Overrides) is preserved inside the collapsible. The collapsed/expanded state persists in localStorage key 'rorca:forge:advancedOpen'. Expand/collapse uses a smooth CSS transition on max-height.
acceptanceCriteria: All configuration fields (spec name, domain, model, story count, prefix, diagram, output format, L4/L5 overrides) are hidden under collapsed Advanced Options by default
Clicking the toggle expands the section with smooth CSS transition
When all fields are at defaults, toggle shows 'Advanced Options' with 'Using defaults' hint in muted text
When any field is customized, toggle shows count badge (e.g. 'Advanced Options (2 customized)')
Spec name field inside Advanced Options shows auto-generated slug as placeholder, allowing user override
Collapsing and expanding does not reset any field values
advancedOpen state persists in localStorage across sessions

userStories.title: Smart Defaults — Auto Story Count and Defaults Summary
userStories.description: Add an 'Auto' option as the first choice in the story count selector (before 3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20). When Auto is selected, storyCount is sent as 0 to the API. Backend specs.ts lines 502-513: when storyCount is 0 or null, change the prompt from 'Generate exactly N stories' to 'Generate an appropriate number of user stories (typically 3-20) based on the scope and complexity of the brief. Use fewer stories for focused features and more for large system changes.' The model selector defaults to the workspace's preferred model (already resolved via defaultModelId). Add a visible defaults summary line near the Generate button showing current effective configuration: e.g. 'Auto stories | claude-sonnet-4-5 | JSON output'. This summary updates reactively when Advanced Options fields change. Auto story count is the initial default for new users (no existing localStorage value).
acceptanceCriteria: Story count selector includes 'Auto' as the first option before numeric presets
When Auto is selected, API call sends storyCount: 0
Backend generates flexible prompt ('appropriate number 3-20') when storyCount is 0 or missing
Defaults summary line below the brief shows effective config (story count, model name, output format)
Summary updates reactively as Advanced Options fields change
Auto is the initial default for new users with no localStorage value
Existing localStorage story count values are respected (no breaking change)

userStories.title: Command Palette Brief-First Entry and Hotkey
userStories.description: Enhance the Command Palette to support the brief-first flow. (1) The existing 'New Spec' action (CommandPalette.tsx line 258, action:new-spec) should navigate to Forge with the brief textarea focused. (2) The Forge fallback feature (lines 340-354, triggers when typing 2+ words with no match, shows 'Send to Forge as brief') should pre-fill the brief and trigger the auto-generated spec name preview from FG-001 immediately. (3) Add keyboard shortcut Cmd+Shift+N (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+N (Windows/Linux) that opens Forge directly with the brief textarea focused from any panel. Register this in the hotkeys system (useHotkeys hook or inline in App.tsx). (4) Verify the forgeBrief state flow in App.tsx (lines 276-280) clears correctly after consumption — the setTimeout clearing at line 279 may need adjustment if the Forge panel re-mounts on navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting 'New Spec' from Command Palette navigates to Forge with brief textarea focused
Forge fallback ('Send to Forge as brief') pre-fills brief textarea and auto slug preview updates immediately
Cmd+Shift+N (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+N (Windows) opens Forge with brief focused from any panel
forgeBrief state is consumed once and cleared correctly, preventing stale state on subsequent navigations
Typing in Command Palette and hitting Enter on Forge fallback transitions seamlessly to brief-first Forge with query as brief text

userStories.title: Update Output Pane Empty State for Brief-First Flow
userStories.description: Update the SpecForgeOutput empty state (SpecForgeOutput.tsx lines 83-97) to reflect the brief-first flow. Current text says 'Configure and generate your first spec' which implies filling out form fields. Change to 'Write a brief and hit Generate' or 'Your generated spec will appear here'. Add a 'Start from template' link/button in the empty state that opens the TemplatePickerModal (pass an onOpenTemplatePicker callback from SpecForgePanelPage). When a template is selected from the output pane, the brief textarea populates and focuses (same behavior as existing template picker). The empty state visual design (wand icon, centered layout) remains consistent with the current design language.
acceptanceCriteria: Output pane empty state text reflects brief-first flow (no mention of 'configuring' fields)
Empty state includes a 'Start from template' link that opens TemplatePickerModal
When a template is selected from the output pane empty state, brief textarea populates and focuses
Empty state visual design (wand icon, centered layout, dashed border) remains consistent with current design
